title: Maintain essential building services
what: Use and maintain the building as the Act requires, including its essential building services under a schedule of maintenance (s 206, not quoted).

sources.title: Building Act 2016 (Tas)
sources.quote: A responsible owner of a building must ensure that the building is used and maintained in accordance with this Act

reach.condition: if it owns a building with essential fire safety measures (such as alarms, sprinklers or exit lighting)
